messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: PagerDuty alert fired for service `gpu-hosts`. Trigger: kernel_panic on host `gpu-oxford-12` (10.4.12.7). Severity: high. Pager: on-call (alice). Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P12345

pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 created and notifying: alice, bob. Auto-escalation in 5 minutes if unacked.

alice: acked. I'm on it — pulling logs and checking node reachability.

alice: quick status: `kubectl get nodes -o wide` shows `gpu-oxford-12   NotReady  gpu   3d` and `ROUTE: 10.4.12.7`. Several pods on that node show `Evicted` and `CrashLoopBackOff`.

alice: trying to SSH to host... ssh times out. console looks dead. Opening IPMI/serial console now.

alice: (serial console) paste:
```
[   23.456789] Kernel panic - not syncing: VFS: Unable to mount root fs
[   23.456790] CPU: 0 PID: 1 Comm: swapper/0 Not tainted 5.10.0-58-generic #64-Ubuntu
[   23.456795] Call Trace:
[   23.456800]  dump_stack+0x6d/0x90
[   23.456805]  panic+0x101/0x2a0
```
Looks like a hard kernel panic.

bob: thx. Could be hardware. Can you hit the BMC? ipmitool or provider console. If BMC reachable attempt `chassis power cycle` first.

alice: BMC reachable. Running: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.4.12.8 -U ADMIN -P **** chassis power cycle` now.

alice: power cycle done. Host boots to grub but kubelet still not healthy. `systemctl status kubelet` shows it keeps failing with segfault in CRI shim. journal tail:
```
Mar 03 01:15:12 kubelet[1234]: fatal error: unexpected signal during runtime execution
Mar 03 01:15:12 kubelet[1234]: SIGSEGV: segmentation fault
Mar 03 01:15:12 kubelet[1234]: goroutine 1 [running]:
```

carol: since node unstable, cordon+drain to evacuate remaining pods. Also check scheduled inference jobs — we may have customer impact for dedicated pools.

alice: cordoning node: `kubectl cordon gpu-oxford-12` -> Done. Starting drain: `kubectl drain gpu-oxford-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` -> some pods failed to evict (GPU-exclusive workloads).

dave: customer-ops here. Impact: AcmeCorp inference cluster lost 2/5 replicas (on gpu-oxford-12). They're seeing elevated latencies and OOMs on failover hosts. Notified acct team and created support ticket SUP-789.

bob: can we relocate AcmeCorp pods to other GPU nodes? If capacity tight, consider burst to dedicated spare or enable fallback to cpu-mode in their policy.

alice: rescheduled 3 GPU pods to gpu-berlin-3 and gpu-nyc-1. AcmeCorp replicas: 2/5 restored, 1 pending due to quota. Latency improving.

carol: good. Escalating to eng-infra for hardware trace and deeper kernel debug. bob — can you pick this up once Alice hands off?

bob: on it. I'll run memtest and collect dmesg + hardware logs, and open ticket with colo provider.

alice: adding notes to the incident: initial kernel panic looks like filesystem or device failure on boot. Hard power cycle recovered system partially but kubelet process still crashes. We evacuated workloads and limited customer impact by moving replicas.

dave: informing AcmeCorp: "We experienced a GPU host failure that temporarily reduced capacity for your inference pool. We've restored 2 of 5 replicas and are continuing restoration. Full postmortem to follow."

alice: handing off to bob for follow-up. OOO in 30m. Please keep incident open until eng-infra confirms hardware health.

bob: ack takeover. Will collect logs: `/var/log/kern.log`, `dmesg -T`, `ipmitool sel list`, and run `smartctl` on local NVMe. Also will request host RMA if mem/cpu/fatal errors show.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 acknowledged by alice and assigned to bob. Escalation paused.

carol: quick customer impact summary for post-incident report: "Single GPU host kernel panic caused partial capacity loss for dedicated inference pool affecting AcmeCorp (2/5 replicas degraded). No data loss reported. Mitigation: cordon+drain, reschedule to other nodes, contact provider for hardware postmortem."

alice: :thumbsup: thanks team. Leaving the channel — bob will continue.

bob: updating incident with collected logs and provider ticket PT-452. Next steps: run hardware diagnostics, if memtest passes, examine kubelet binary/libraries for corruption.

carol: schedule follow-up RCA in 48 hours; include infra, runtime, and SRE.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 status: monitoring after mitigation. Resolved when hardware investigation completes.

bob: quick note: found ECC errors in `ipmitool sel list` and SMART reallocated sectors on NVMe. Opened RMA with provider. Marking node as unschedulable until replacement.

alice: (final) thanks — handoff complete. bob owns follow-up.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 updated: last update by bob at 1782513600.

carol: :white_check_mark: moving to postmortem planning.
